objective: Assess a proposed parallel coding-agent design

tasks.title: Scheduler review
tasks.prompt: List the scheduler invariants and identify two concurrency failure modes.

tasks.title: Workspace review
tasks.prompt: Propose an isolated-workspace and patch-integration strategy.

tasks.title: Metrics review
tasks.prompt: Define metrics for throughput, accepted goodput, latency, and overload.

tasks.title: Test review
tasks.prompt: Propose deterministic scheduler tests and a local-server load test.

tasks.title: Risk synthesis
tasks.prompt: Combine scheduler and workspace findings into a prioritized risk register.

tasks.title: Final integrated review
tasks.prompt: Return a concise integrated assessment with implementation priorities and acceptance tests.
